parsing_rationale: The document was analyzed as a technical constitution. I mapped the 'Best Practices & Standards' section to 'Coding Standards & Style' and the 'Development Workflow' section to 'Branching & PR Workflow'. The 'Technology Stack' was treated as a source for tool configurations. Since no specific testing gates (automated tests, CI/CD) or open questions were mentioned, these were flagged as structural gaps.

project_info.brief_explanation: Technical governance and quality standards for an article management e-commerce project.
